Root cause: _query_one_vault's cross-vault final_score scored the LIKE path on raw term occurrence count; the in-vault SQL ORDER BY already normalizes by body length but that normalization never reached the score used for RRF fusion, so a huge unrelated document could out-rank a compact on-topic one purely on bulk. Fixed by scoring term density (matching the SQL ordering) and adding an oversize penalty + content cap (mirrors the existing noise-marker penalty: demoted, never dropped) in src/nougen_shards/connectors/local_vault.py. New test tests/test_local_vault_scoring.py reproduces the exact failure shape and is confirmed red on pre-fix code, green post-fix. PR open: https://github.com/Who-Visions/NouGenShards/pull/106.
